task: D2 cross-scoring of existing models on driven A5 pass-2 CRM routes (diagnosis only)

definitions.logit: ensemble mean of member route logits (log sum softplus hazard)
definitions.within_group_auc: pairs (failed, succeeded) of distinct routes of the same group, concordant + 0.5 ties, pooled over pairs; CI = 2000 group bootstrap
definitions.regret: fail(argmin logit among the group's driven routes) - min fail over them, mean over groups, in points
definitions.clogit: exact conditional logistic likelihood per group (P(failure set | number of failures)), features standardised on the training folds, L2 1e-3, group-level 5-fold CV (fold = md5(group) % 5); vx is constant within a group, so it enters only through interactions

H_masked.description: same H checkpoints, history all masked (the A5 Hmask arm)

T.description: oracle domain tag model, tag = crm

P.description: pooled model, no label, no history

CRM_N2_legacy.description: deployed legacy CRM ensemble (crm_f104_v1, standing-start rows only)

soil-competent arms only (routes picked.label: soil-competent arms only (routes picked by H, Hmask, T, P or Spcrm)
